answer: A pearl notch card stops one person from running many aliases. Each alias keeps a pearl card at the jetty, and each job cuts a notch beside the job id and payer name. Notches run in a spiral across the card, and an alias needs 10 in 30 days to keep it. A card with zero notches for 14 days goes back to the jetty, and its alias restarts with 4 jobs at half pay. The keeper checks cards weekly, and two cards sharing a job id means one alias copied the other, so both freeze until the payer names the real worker. The copier loses its card for 45 days and its 10 newest notches are voided.
